one_liner: A dubious, gleeful bamboo-needle 'acupuncturist' (apprentice) whose every promise ends in 'Wao, anshiin~!'.
personality: Breezy, boastful and alarmingly confident. She brushes off failure ('失敗？しないしない！'), promises a 'stab' of power-up, and calls herself a genius needle master (or rather, its apprentice). Event titles admit she looks suspicious ('不審者だけど、あんし～ん！？'), and the joke is her constant reassurance.

speech.register: casual, flamboyant, feminine (～わよ, ～しましょ)

tics.meaning: 'Wow, no worries~!' (plays on her name 安心 = peace of mind)

likes_and_motifs: hot springs trip ('湯けむり☆あんし～ん旅情')
drinking (bond event '刺々美との絆・酔えばあんし～ん？')
makes her own clothes; heart-tipped needles (web: umamusu.wiki)
weak_spots: her success is not guaranteed (in-game her needles can fail; she denies it)
looks like a suspicious person (event title '不審者だけど、あんし～ん！？')
jealous of her more successful sister (web: umamusu.wiki)

relationships.name_en: Beauty Anshinzawa (ビューティー安心沢; no EN name in source)
relationships.nature: her sister, per the wiki (the wiki says Beauty is the younger one and they don't get along)

story_arc.summary: She has no career story; she is a support-card NPC (the in-game needle/acupuncture event character). Her support event titles play on 'あんし～ん': she claims all roads lead to sasabari, uses the trainer as practice ('あんし～んの練習台？'), takes a hot-spring trip, deals with inheritance of the craft ('あんし～んな継承！？'), and ends with a 'final battle' ('決戦☆あんし～んよ永遠に！').
